topic: The most abundant gas in Earth's atmosphere by volume
core_question: Which gas makes up the largest percentage of Earth's atmosphere by volume? (secondary: Who holds the current men's world record for the 100 meter sprint?)
answer_summary: The answer is nitrogen (N2), which makes up about 78% of Earth's atmosphere by volume, more than oxygen's roughly 21%.; after the topic shift: The answer is Usain Bolt, the Jamaican sprinter who set the men's 100m world record of 9.58 seconds at the 2009 World Championships in Berlin, a record still standing.
persona: skeptical and testy; writing terse one-liners
